label: Temperament system (global)
description: Superordinate node: biologically rooted, early-appearing dispositions in reactivity and self-regulation; interfaces with all other UPG strata

label: Genetic/physiological substrate
description: Genetic influences and psychophysiological systems (limbic/striatal reactivity, frontal regulation networks); interface to biology

label: Negative affectivity
description: Reactive dimension: fear, anger/frustration, sadness, discomfort; convergent across all classic models

label: Surgency / positive affectivity
description: Reactive dimension: approach, activity, sociability, high-intensity pleasure

label: Effortful control
description: Self-regulation dimension: attentional and inhibitory control modulating reactivity

label: Configural types
description: Person-centered profiles over the dimensions (easy/difficult/slow-to-warm; inhibited/uninhibited)
primary_source: Thomas & Chess (1977)*; Kagan & Snidman (1991); Murillo et al. (2024)

label: Goodness of fit
description: Relational node: match between temperament and environmental demands/expectations

label: Caregiving / environmental demands
description: Parenting, school, and cultural expectations; interface node to Systems and Development strata

label: Maladjustment risk
description: Internalizing/externalizing risk channel; interface node to the Disorder stratum (UDG)

label: Personality trait layer
description: Interface node to the Personality stratum (UPerG): temperament as initial conditions of the Big Five hierarchy

label: Temperament-by-temperament moderation
description: One dimension moderates another's risk pathway (e.g., EC moderates BI-anxiety link)

label: Temperament-by-environment moderation
description: Environment moderates temperament-outcome links; includes differential susceptibility

label: Regulatory maturation
description: Developmental strengthening of frontal control networks over reactive systems

label: Fear
description: Threat-related distress and withdrawal; FFFS-linked

label: Anger/frustration
description: Blocked-goal distress; approach-linked negative affect

label: Sadness
description: Loss- and disappointment-related lowered mood and energy

label: Discomfort
description: Sensory-stimulation-related distress

label: Soothability (reversed)
description: Recovery rate from distress; loads negatively

label: Activity level
description: Gross motor activity rate and intensity

label: Sociability
description: Preference for being with others

label: Approach / anticipation
description: Positive excitement toward expected rewards; BAS-linked

label: High-intensity pleasure
description: Enjoyment of high-stimulation contexts

label: Attentional focusing
description: Capacity to sustain and shift attention deliberately

label: Inhibitory control
description: Capacity to suppress prepotent responses

label: Perceptual sensitivity
description: Detection of low-intensity environmental stimulation

label: Low-intensity pleasure
description: Enjoyment of low-stimulation contexts

label: Easy type
description: Regular, approaching, adaptable, mild, positive profile (NYLS)

label: Difficult type
description: Irregular, withdrawing, slow-adapting, intense, negative profile (NYLS)

label: Slow-to-warm-up type
description: Mildly negative initial withdrawal with slow adaptation (NYLS)

label: Inhibited / uninhibited
description: High- vs low-reactive infant biases toward novelty (Kagan)
